prompts.prompt: Calm, atmospheric, non-graphic. Quiet, expectant mood. Signs are abstract glowing shapes with no letters.

prompts.prompt: Somber, investigative, non-graphic. Surreal editorial illustration: an enormous brass clockwork mechanism whose gears are built from miniature city blocks, palm trees, hotel towers and neon tubes, glowing softly at dusk. At its center sits a single empty leather executive chair under a spotlight, waiting. Wide composition, deep perspective, investigative documentary tone.

Cold, ominous, non-graphic. Night view of an imposing 1980s downtown skyscraper with a smoked-glass facade and a lit marble lobby. At street level, a blank polished brass plaque beside the revolving door; two black limousines idle at the curb with their headlights on. Wet pavement reflections, cold blue and gold palette, sense of quiet power.
